title: Cut: execution
situation: Cut 4's bookkeeping (0025) and cut 2's remains (0054) both concern how a cut is carried out. Efficiency (0020) said each cut's figures would be recorded durably; so far they live only in reports and two acceptance reasons. Figures so far: cut 2 22 whole-check runs and not accepted; cut 3 2 whole-check runs, 5 builder and 9 check-writer dispatches; cut 6 2 runs, 5 builder, 4 check-writer, 15 live evals; agent launch 2 runs, 2 builder; catalog re-cut 2 runs, 9 builder in one wide round; whole-declaration launch 2 runs.
decision: One execution cut: the work package capability (submitted and updated work packages, every concept served, computed levels, refusing an empty dispatch, the canonical example inventory, a commit guard that knows which builder commits, whole-check runs counted per round, a round with no progress flagged), cut 2's structural examples and cut 4's (cut 2's examples 6, 7 and 9 and held-out 2, 5 and 7) as structural examples, cut 2's behavioral examples as evaluations of the composed roles, and each cut's efficiency figures recorded by the capability where reconstitution reads them.
consequences: Follows cut 5 if the operator so orders (0043's check proof first); 0036's order is the operator's to revise.
